decisions.reason: Changing the score's size, heading, and prominence does not alter the separately defined content or bullet-point format of the result explanation.
The dashboard presentation change does not change which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The final-page confidentiality warning is independent of the front-page score presentation.
The front-page score heading and prominence do not require any change to the internal-page header.
The dashboard refinement is compatible with the existing premium visual-style requirement and does not necessarily change its current attributes.
The source dashboard modification does not change the footer's presentation or page coverage.
Renaming the score heading and increasing score prominence do not alter the RR-01 report identifier rule.
The source changes how the score and risk outcome are presented, not how scores map to report variants, risk bands, or exposure levels.
The dashboard presentation refinement does not change the required reusable fonts, icons, or design-asset handoff.
The front-page dashboard modification does not change the required editable formats, report variants, or PDF-export capability.
